top_signals.title: Semiconductor market to remain solid ‘at least through next year,’ South Korea finance minister says
top_signals.summary: South Korea's finance minister said semiconductor growth can last at least through 2027 as supply remains tight despite a global chip sell-off.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
